names: Francisco Manuel Lumbrales de Sá Carneiro
summary: Francisco Sá Carneiro (1934–1980) was a founder and leader of the Social Democratic Party who was prime minister from January 1980 until he died in an air crash at Camarate in December of that year. He is in the atlas as the head of government whose turn at the office ended with his death in post.
